notes: Hand-authored, not derived: a locate key is a judgement about where a behaviour lives, not a mechanical reference set. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root; tests/** is excluded from every key in this directory. src/hooks/shortcut-match.ts holds parseShortcut / prefersMetaKey / matchesShortcut — the entire decision, including the mod-means-Meta-or-Control resolution the prompt asks about. EXCLUDED: src/hooks/use-keyboard-shortcut.ts, which binds the DOM listener and delegates the matching (its own header says the modifier rules were split out so they could be tested without a DOM event loop); src/hooks/command-groups.ts and src/components/ui/command-palette.tsx, which only declare shortcut tokens.
